title: Behavioral Regression Detection for Pull Requests via Structured Oracles
abstract: arXiv:2610.35223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software regressions are unintended behavioral changes introduced by code modifications and are hard to detect at pull-request (PR) level. Existing methods rely on incomplete tests or directly analyze PRs via LLMs, lacking structured behavioral reasoning and explicit oracles. We present ORION, a staged framework for PR-level regression detection. ORION extracts PR intent and identifies impacted functions via AST-based impact analysis, then synthesizes function-level structured behavioral oracles encoding preserved/changed behaviors, setup constraints and control-flow hints from PR intent, static risk signals and code changes. Guided by these oracles, ORION generates executable tests, conducts oracle-coverage-guided augmentation and static repair, and differentially runs tests on pre- and post-change code. translated_title: 基于结构化预言的拉取请求行为回归检测
translated_abstract: 软件回归是指代码修改所引入的非预期行为变化，这类问题在拉取请求（PR）级别难以检测。现有方法依赖于不完整的测试，或者直接通过大语言模型（LLM）分析PR，缺乏结构化的行为推理和显式的预言。我们提出了ORION，一个用于PR级别回归检测的分阶段框架。ORION首先提取PR意图，并通过基于抽象语法树（AST）的影响分析识别受影响的函数，然后综合生成函数级别的结构化行为预言，这些预言从PR意图、静态风险信号和代码变更中编码了保留/变更的行为、设置约束和控制流提示。在这些预言的指导下，ORION生成可执行的测试，进行预言覆盖率引导的测试增强与静态修复，并在变更前后的代码上差异化地运行测试。它采用确定性规则与受约束的LLM推理相结合的方式对PR进行分类。我们构建了RegBench-Py，这是首个Python PR回归基准（测试集）。
tldr: ORION通过从PR意图合成结构化行为预言并引导可执行测试的生成与差分执行，实现了拉取请求级别的行为回归检测，同时发布了首个Python PR回归基准RegBench-Py。
en_tdlr: ORION detects pull-request-level behavioral regressions by synthesizing structured behavioral oracles from PR intent to guide executable test generation and differential execution, and introduces RegBench-Py, the first Python PR regression benchmark.
